title: Playing a might-focused Warden with defensive perks, I never once felt meaningfully threatened by combat across 568 turns and dozens of fights (HP dipped only a few points per encounter at most) — death never felt like a real possibility for this build/path, which undercuts the game's own 'hp0 = death' framing from the intro.
